scope: Existing Scene2D editing with per-field projection overrides, recoverable v8 updates and stale plan invalidation on the existing uncommitted development tree

application.command: VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY=<temporary archive helper> VIENTO_MOBILE_STORE_BIN=<temporary mobile helper> VIENTO_GODOT_BIN=<cached Godot> npm run check -- --app-only

browser.command: VIENTO_GODOT_BIN=<cached Godot> VIENTO_SCENE_EDIT_OUTPUT=<new evidence directory> node scripts/tests/scene-edit-smoke.mjs

sceneEditIntegration.tools: Real Godot, native desktop archive and native mobile storage helper; also rerun in final full application check

nativeHelpers.command: CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<temporary target> cargo build --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example workspace-archive --example mobile-storage

coverage: Same scene UUID, document type and path; name, canvas, actor membership and field configuration editable through the existing dialog.
Per-field overrides work in creation and editing; absent inheritance fields, explicit false and imageResourceId:null remain distinct.
BOM, CRLF, unmodified numeric spellings and actor fragments survive exact source rewriting; no-op saves produce no transaction.
New dependencies appended without deleting prior relations, bindings, OC/projection source or media.

v8 two-existing-file transactions guard even unchanged metadata, reject forged journals, recover after seven publication boundaries and after a second interruption; external actor source remains untouched.
Scene drafts survive failed or inconsistent reads, revisions and unknown apply outcomes.
Saving invalidates the remembered plan job; old successful status responses cannot re-enable stale generation, while a genuinely new plan may reuse the same snapshot.
Old scenes using actor-only image bindings can be edited and recovered; no-op does not append redundant scene bindings.
Selective resource packages retain current and historical dependencies; native desktop/mobile full archives preserve exact authored bytes, identities and build snapshots.
Real Chrome three-language 390px workflow reaches actual Godot: only current actors run, scene speed override moves the player 80px and controls override holds the other actor stationary.
initialFailuresAndFixes: Initial browser entry was hidden because the HTTP capabilities list lacked scene.update; added declaration plus HTTP assertion and reran final browser successfully.
Initial core run also exposed a shallow-copy fixture mutation; fixture isolation fixed. Sandbox process restrictions were retried using the authorized temporary-test environment.
Static review found actor-bound image compatibility missing from registry-only validation; added guarded bindings and no-op regression.
limitations: No packaged Tauri window or Android device acceptance; real browser HTTP and native storage helpers were tested separately.
Headless runtime logic checked; graphical runtime window and physical keyboard were not repeated.
No full Rust unit rerun: native source unchanged; helper compilation and interoperability were exercised.
Scene editing remains a form, with no draggable scene canvas or arbitrary behavior scripting.
Historical dependencies are preserved and can enlarge selection packages; there is no implicit deletion of source objects or assets.
No version bump, commit, push, package installation or actual-work data migration.
